name: Bethany Benjamin
pull: I am actually doing it, feeling and living change, not just reading about it.
head: Carrie has opened up my mind to new possibilities for my life!
body: I am starting to feel alive again. I’m hopeful again, I let myself explore better options, think more positive thoughts, and laugh a little more each day.

I have finally begun to feel some peace in my life and true hope and excitement for what I am creating and what is to come. Carrie’s work is not only super comprehensive but it’s the closest to the real life “experience” there is – I am actually doing it, feeling and living change not just reading about it.

name: Jim Stippich
pull: Sessions with Carrie showed positive results almost immediately.
head: Carrie expertly guided me through an extremely low point in my life.
body: Together we identified what was causing my mind to “spin” rather than focus and created a clear path of how to move forward. Sessions with Carrie showed positive results almost immediately.
It isn’t simple and it does take work, but with help from someone like Carrie it’s a very doable and incredibly rewarding journey.

name: Candice Sanders
pull: I learned how I was standing in my own way, how to remove my blocks and gain clarity.
head: With Carrie’s help, I discovered where I really needed to focus my time and energies.
body: Working with Carrie, I started attaining the goals I had always wanted to reach. Carrie is highly compassionate and one hundred percent committed to facilitating a client’s growth, while also helping them become more aware in the process, so they can learn to tackle this type of work on their own.

I learned how I was standing in my own way, how to remove my blocks and gain clarity, and to create actionable plans to move forward towards my ultimate goals. I could not have asked for a better experience!

name: Rebecca Blaylock
pull: Helping me open doors of possibilities I never even thought I had available before.
head: If you are looking for true, lasting change in your life, whether professional or personal, you have found your guide!
body: I had recently quit my last job, decided on a career change, and was completely unsure of where I was to go from there. I was living in a constant state of fear.

I instantly connected with her as she opened up my eyes to the reality I had created for myself. She showed me grace, compassion and told me hard truths that I needed to hear in order to regain confidence and power from within. She has been my confidant and guide throughout the entire career change process, helping me open doors of possibilities I never even thought I had available before, but that had been there all along.

She has an innate talent in knowing exactly what it is you need from each session. She provides life-altering advice and perspectives that allow you to see beyond the limitations of the mind, and become the true co-creator of your life that you have always been.

name: Allison McAfee
pull: In very few sessions I was already feeling more hopeful, excited, and taking the steps I had been unable to take before.
head: My experience with Carrie was profound!
body: My first session left me with a feeling of clarity, excitement for what could be possible, and inspiration to finally take action. Carrie is an exceptional listener and has an incredible ability to help her clients process their experience without being afraid or cautious.

In very few sessions I was already feeling more hopeful, excited, and taking the steps I had been unable to take before. I highly recommend her for anyone who wants to cast light on their core being and to connect with their true self for life-long fulfillment.

name: Ryan Lang
pull: Far deeper and more effective than I had ever imagined, and changes came very quickly.
head: The Self-Mastery™ work was far deeper and more effective than I had ever imagined, and changes came very quickly.
body: Carrie’s holistic approach within Self-Mastery™, along with the core modules that I have access to forever, powerful Master Coaching calls, and frequent contact and coaching with her brought me to a level in my life I have never experienced.
Carrie is a very calming and loving influence, while providing an invigorating stream of motivation. She has been beyond instrumental in helping me pave a path to success in all areas of my life.

name: Lance Scheele
pull: Clear, precise tools and definable skills I could implement at any given moment.
head: For the first time in years, I feel I am exactly where I want to be.
body: I started working with Carrie due to some personal struggles in both my professional and personal life. At the time, I felt stuck, confused, and disconnected from myself and those around me.

Carrie provided me with clear, precise tools and definable skills I could IMPLEMENT at any given moment. For the first time in years, I feel I am exactly where I want to be, I have a clear path forward, but most importantly, I feel grounded in my daily life with a peace and happiness that I know is sustainable.

name: Kathleen Fee
pull: She is truly POWERFUL and will guide you on an incredible journey to your most magnificent self.
head: Carrie Bowman’s expert coaching style sent me on a wisdom quest that would ultimately unlock my most successful and provocative ideas.
body: She is truly POWERFUL and will guide you on an incredible journey to your most magnificent self. You do not want to miss this!

name: Michelle Violette
pull: Carrie raises the bar for other life coaches.
head: Work with Carrie and you’ll find yourself creating the life you’ve always desired.
body: Carrie raises the bar for other life coaches. She is a professional who embodies authenticity, integrity, spirit and unconditional love. Her coaching services are humbly, yet masterfully offered within a sacred space co-created with you and for you.

Should you make the invaluable decision to partner with Carrie as your coach, you’ll find yourself enjoying an experience full of self-discovery, empowerment, excitement and growth. You’ll find you’re creating the life you’ve always desired.

name: Kimberly Stewart
pull: Today, I am able to hear what is in my heart, and I have found fulfillment from within.
head: Carrie will open your eyes to the life that is possible for you.
body: I found Carrie at a time in my life when I was struggling with the question, “what comes next?”. I had no explanation for why my life felt so empty and void of purpose, but I felt completely detached from myself, my relationships, and my work. I was lost.

Today, I am able to hear what is in my heart, and I have found fulfillment from within. My most important relationship is with myself, and I have aligned my life with the practices that keep me connected. If you are ready, she will take you on a journey of self-discovery that will open your eyes to the life that is possible.

name: Mary Ann O’Reilly
pull: She speaks from a place of absolute truth.
head: Carrie is the REAL DEAL.
body: She speaks from a place of absolute truth, has lived a life of zero BS and has an unbelievably generous heart.
Time spent with Carrie will reap huge lifelong benefits. I’m so grateful for her coaching.

name: Jennifer Fields
pull: I have experienced a shift of coming back to my true self.
head: With Carrie’s guidance, I’ve come out the other side.
body: After many years of thinking about doing it, I finally made the decision to engage a life coach. I was full of fear, which was holding me back. I had forgotten how to listen to who I was and what I wanted.

From my first conversation with Carrie, I was elated. Through her coaching, I’ve come out the other side. I have experienced a shift of coming back to my true self. I know this is just the beginning, and that my future is abundant with opportunity.

name: Katherine Mason
pull: Self-Mastery™ is one of the best investments I’ve ever made.
head: If you’re ready for a real shift in your life, the Self-Mastery™ Program is where to begin.
body: After struggling to overcome some unhelpful patterns, I was able to pinpoint why I was getting stuck and how I could take tangible action. Carrie is incredibly supportive, empathetic, and knowledgeable in the realm of inner work and what it takes to make lasting change.

One of my favorite things about her program was how applicable it is in all facets of your life. Need help with career direction, sense of purpose, or guidance through a major life transition? All of the tools she provides go above and beyond what initially brings you to the work. It was absolutely worth it!

name: Jennifer Minton
pull: Truly, for the first time in my life, I came home to who I am as a human being.
head: Truly, for the first time in my life, I came home to who I am as a human being.
body: Since working with Carrie, I’ve learned how to set boundaries and stick with them, I’ve learned that I am worthy of only engaging in things that give me joy, I’ve learned that I don’t have to people-please to earn respect from them, and so much more.

As much as this work is challenging, uncomfortable and frustrating it is ten folds rewarding, fulfilling, and I’ve only scraped the surface. My relationships in all aspects of my life have flourished, personally and professionally.

name: Leah Rambur
pull: The perfect mix of candor and compassion.
head: Working with Carrie through the Self-Mastery™ Program was pivotal in my journey to gain clarity and has turned out to be one of the best investments that I have made.
body: When I reached out to Carrie, my life was far from being in disarray externally. I had a great job with an abundance of freedom, I was financially thriving, and I was living in the location I had only dreamed about. But I would go through periods of feeling that my life was perfectly on track to moments and seasons where I felt unexplainably unsettled.

Her Self-Mastery™ work and coaching sessions integrated concepts that I had never explored despite having invested numerous years in personal development. One of my favorite things about Carrie is her uncanny ability to provide the perfect mix of candor and compassion.

name: Jerame Maes
pull: I now have a stronger tendency to slow down and observe the anxiety… instead of fighting against it.
head: The Self-Mastery™ program was exactly what I was searching for: deep and genuine growth.
body: When I reached out to Carrie, I was stuck in a spot where I was longing for fast answers. I was constantly overwhelmed in my day to day. I thought I was looking for a coach who would feed me advice toward those answers. Yet, what I found was a coach who took a deeper approach to gently guide me in discovering the deeper mechanisms which contributed to the anxiety and overwhelm.

Self-awareness and new, more adaptive skills and tools are a large part of Carrie’s program and through developing these practices, I now have a stronger tendency to slow down and observe the anxiety in a way that allows me to work with it instead of fighting against it. This is a huge shift for me.

name: Lauren Trussell
pull: Carrie’s immersive program dives deep from the very start.
head: If you are willing to do the work, this coaching can powerfully transform your life.
body: Before I found Carrie, I had done several years of traditional therapy, as well as worked with a teacher that focused more on visualizations and manifestation. When I found Carrie, I was seeking a way to integrate the cognitive with the spiritual.

Carrie’s approach has taught me to understand and work with my body, emotions, mind, and spirit. In contrast to traditional therapy, which can sometimes feel slow in terms of producing real results in our lives, Carrie’s immersive program dives deep from the very start.

name: Cathy Moore
pull: Exactly what I’d been searching for for so many years.
head: My work with Carrie in the Self-Mastery™ Program kickstarted a transformational journey in my life that was exactly what I’d been searching for for so many years!
body: I had an idea of what I wanted when I started working with Carrie but no clue about what that would look like. My work with Carrie opened up a whole world that I had barely been exposed to before. Carrie is so patient, knowledgeable, understanding and time spent with her and the group sessions was beyond valuable.

I highly recommend the Self-Mastery™ program especially for those at a point in their life where they are ready to put in the work to understand how to better navigate life’s challenges and fully connect with themselves and their greater purpose.

name: Kelly Vivian
pull: I feel fundamentally different in my life and forever grateful.
head: The Self-Mastery™ Program has helped me in incredible ways and faster than I had even imagined.
body: I had always felt misunderstood and, after speaking with Carrie the first time, finally felt I had found someone who understood my struggles. I left our first call with a clear vision of where I wanted to be, and she expertly provided the strategic path to get me there.

The program gave me a deeper understanding of myself and why I reacted to certain people and situations in different ways. I feel more alive, confident, and able to communicate and relate with others as I never could before. I feel fundamentally different in my life and forever grateful.

name: Chad Gabriel
pull: Today I am more fulfilled and happy than I have ever been.
head: Today I am more fulfilled and happy than I have ever been.
body: I reached out to Carrie while I was traversing some incredibly difficult transitions and I was really struggling with adjusting to my new life and experiences. I felt fearful about being alone and I began to really second-guess and hesitate, not only who I truly was, but my value as a person.

Today (and in a very short period of time, too), I am now living day-to-day comfortable in my own skin. I am secure in my life, full of self-awareness and gratitude for what once used to be confusion and doubt. That has spilled into the other aspects of my life and it just keeps getting better.

name: Amanda Rystedt
pull: I can honestly say she was my angel in disguise.
head: I can honestly say she was my angel in disguise.
body: I knew where I wanted to be in life but didn’t have the tools and support to get me to where I was going and felt as though I was perhaps at rock bottom and knew in my heart that the only way was up, but how?

I’ll never forget my first session with that extraordinary woman. So many emotions were felt that day. Tears of sadness, relief knowing there was hope and a sense that a weight was lifted off my shoulders. The coaching, guidance and tools Carrie has given and taught me the last year has not only helped me in the here and now but it’s something that I will utilize for the rest of my life.

name: Kristin Leiber
pull: I went from a corporate financial accountant to a hospitality small business owner (a COMPLETE 180).
head: Working with Carrie will be a life-changing experience.
body: I came to Carrie at one of the most difficult points of my life. In my mind, I was struggling with the direction of my career. In reality, I was juggling anxiety, restlessness, a new marriage, increasingly unfulfilling work, and dreams that seemed impossible.

Carrie helped me navigate a complete career change, and because of her, I truly was never more at peace than the day I put in my notice. I went from a corporate financial accountant to a hospitality small business owner (a COMPLETE 180), and I have never been happier. She helped me confidently jump to the next lily pad in my life, even when I couldn’t see the outcome.

name: Dave Krauss
pull: Carrie is damn good at what she does.
head: Carrie is damn good at what she does.
body: When I knew I needed a “life coach,” it was in a moment of fog, frustration and vulnerability. I knew myself well enough to know that I wasn’t as incapable as I felt at that time. I simply had lost my connection to that capable side of myself.

Through the weekly sessions with Carrie, we set concrete and realistic goals. By achieving (most) of them, I’ve discovered what works for me and what doesn’t. Her ability to hold up the proverbial mirror so I could see the self-imposed roadblocks was so helpful.

name: Michelle Fuller
pull: I have met or exceeded every short term goal I initially talked to her about.
head: Carrie is so much more than a coach!
body: She will become part of your tribe, a trusted friend, that accountability partner you need. I have been under Carrie’s wing and support for over 90 days now. My life has dramatically shifted. I have met or exceeded every short term goal I initially talked to her about.
My thinking has changed so dramatically I hardly remember “BC” (before Carrie). I can’t begin to convey what 90 days of support and structured guidance can do for you and your life.

name: Patti Risch
pull: Invaluable insights and accelerated growth.
head: Carrie is a gifted and intuitive teacher.
body: Carrie has helped me stand back, assess situations and realign myself as I create and design a former business in a ‘new’ country with courage, confidence and self-compassion.

I have loved learning new strategies and have gained invaluable insights and accelerated growth. What I have most appreciated about Carrie is her compassion, validation and acknowledgement of current life-situation and moving from here with grace.

name: Ashley Cole
pull: Carrie helped me perceive the change in my life as a gift rather than a burden.
head: Carrie helped me perceive the change in my life as a gift rather than a burden.
body: Carrie’s compassion, transparency, intuition, and knowledge helped me clarify my goals and brought exciting opportunities into my life. I thoroughly loved and felt empowered by the collaborative process.
Her support and feedback was direct and relevant to all topics addressed and examined. Thank you, Carrie, for your strong belief in me and my potential.

name: Lauren Ince
pull: Best of all, I am sober today, going on 2.5 years.

body: When I first started working with Carrie, I was in a very dark place. I felt so lost and just totally consumed by all the wrong things in my life. In the past, I went to psychologists, read books, etc. and I wasn’t getting anywhere.

Today, I am happy and living the best life I can. I am also in recovery for alcoholism, and I can honestly say Carrie led me in that direction. With her help, I see life in a completely different way. I live more transparently and am more self aware. Best of all, I am sober today, going on 2.5 years.

name: Laura Casanova
pull: I now live a life with less stress and anxiety and more commitment to myself and what I want in life.
head: I now live a life with less stress and anxiety and more commitment to myself and what I want in life!
body: I reached a point in my career where I began to question whether the situations I found myself in were due to some behavior or pattern I kept repeating. I found Carrie’s Self-Mastery™ Program and our first conversation intrigued me enough to join.

I learned more from Self-Mastery™ than I thought possible! I loved that the program helped me understand what was holding me back from taking the bold steps I wanted to take, and how to break out of the cycle of helplessness and pain I had continued to find myself in.

name: Meredith Fontana
pull: In just a few short months my life became almost unrecognizable.
head: Carrie’s support was instrumental in helping me find the clarity, confidence and direction I needed to discover my authentic self and pursue my passions.
body: Her deep capacity for empathy, compassion and sincerity, along with her intelligence and life experience, always made me feel like I had someone on my team who truly understood me and could guide me through any challenge I faced.
In just a few short months my life became almost unrecognizable compared to when I first started working with Carrie.

name: David Huff
pull: Carrie’s insight into personality, motivation and emotional states is exceptional.
head: Carrie’s insight into personality, motivation, and emotional states is exceptional.
body: Carrie was recommended to me by a friend as an ICF certified coach. I needed some coaching sessions as part of my own coach training. I got so much more than I expected.

On numerous occasions she helped me move through blocks that were hindering my ability to move forward in my work and life. I’m thrilled to recommend Carrie as a coach who gets results, but only if you are willing to change to go to the next level of performance.

name: Lindsay Koch
pull: My life has seemingly opened up to greater purpose, opportunity, growth, and last but not least, JOY!

I would encourage anyone who is experiencing life in any way other than with peace and confidence to work with Carrie, as each time I have worked with her, my life has seemingly opened up to greater purpose, opportunity, growth, and last but not least, JOY!

name: Susan Oliver

name: Kristin Crowell
pull: I found passion in something that I plan to gradually turn into a business.

I highly recommend her services to anyone who is lacking the motivation to make changes or take action, and to anyone who is feeling lost or disenchanted. She’s a fantastic coach!

pull: Carrie has helped me more than any other therapist or coach that I’ve had in my entire life.

My breakthrough in the program came from her suggesting different ideas or ways to think about things, as well as creating greater inner accountability to keep myself disciplined and avoid falling back into my old patterns.
If you’re on the fence about joining her Self-Mastery™ Program, I would suggest going full force with it. It honestly changed my life.
